Technical Consultant with a Background in Economics to Support the Ministry of Health in the Implementation of the State Guaranteed Benefits Program No.1

Qualification Requirements:

  1. Higher education in economics and finance, public administration, health management, or another related field. A Master's degree will be considered an advantage.
  2. At least 10 years of professional experience in healthcare financing, health economics, public finance, health system reforms, or healthcare program management.
  3. Practical experience in the development, implementation, or improvement of healthcare financing mechanisms, including provider payment systems, tariff setting, public financing mechanisms, and financial planning.
  4. Experience in the design or implementation of health system reforms, including projects related to the State Guaranteed Benefits Program and Mandatory Health Insurance, will be considered an asset.
  5. Practical experience in conducting economic analysis, Budget Impact Analysis (BIA), financial mode

, develop practical recommendations, and present findings in a clear and understandable manner.
  • Fluency in Kyrgyz and Russian, both written and spoken. Knowledge of English at a level sufficient to work with international methodological materials and prepare technical documentation will be considered an asset.
